findings.requirements: The UNRESOLVED guard compares the probe against an unstyled control element, so it will also fire when a rule legitimately computes to the same value the control gets — for `color` on a button, a genuinely black rule would be reported UNRESOLVED. That is a false positive in the fail-safe direction and costs nothing today, since no Part B subject resolves to the UA default. Worth a line in the comparator's header so a future author does not chase it as a bug.
